#### [wix.editor.embeds.v1.CustomEmbedsService.UpdateCustomEmbed](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/update-custom-embed) # Package: customEmbeds # Namespace: undefined # Method: Update Custom Embed # Method link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/update-custom-embed # Method API Endpoint: PATCH https://www.wixapis.com/embeds/v1/custom-embeds/{customEmbed.id} ## Method Code Examples ### Available request examples - Update Custom Embed > These are the request examples found in this result. Read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/update-custom-embed and locate an example by its exact title to get it complete. --- Code Example: Update Custom Embed --- ### Update Custom Embed ```javascript curl -X PATCH \ 'https://www.wixapis.com/embeds/v1/custom-embeds/8046df3c-7575-4098-a5ab-c91ad8f33c47' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -H 'Authorization: ' \ -d '{ "customEmbed": { "id": "8046df3c-7575-4098-a5ab-c91ad8f33c47", "revision": "1", "name": "Updated Custom Embed", "enabled": true, "position": "BODY_END", "embedData": { "category": "ANALYTICS", "html": "" } } }' ``` --- Method Response Shape --- ## Method Response Shape ```json { "customEmbed": { "id": "string", "revision": "string", "name": "string", "enabled": "boolean", "loadOnce": "boolean", "domain": "string", "position": "string", "embedData": "object", "pageFilter": "object" } } ``` --- Method Description --- ## Method Description: Updates a custom embed. To prevent conflicting changes, you must pass the current revision number. ## Method Permissions: EDITOR.CUSTOM_EMBED_UPDATE ## Method Permissions Scopes: SCOPE.EDITOR.MANAGE_CUSTOM_EMBEDS: SCOPE.EDITOR.MANAGE_CUSTOM_EMBEDS ## Method Schema Summary: The `updateCustomEmbed` method allows for updating an existing custom embed. It requires the `customEmbed.id` and `customEmbed.revision` to be passed to prevent conflicting changes. The `customEmbed.embedData.category` is also a required parameter. **Method Parameters:** * **customEmbed**: (Object, required) A custom embed entity that manages HTML and JavaScript code, its placement, and properties. * **id**: (String, read-only, required) The unique GUID of the custom embed. * **revision**: (String, read-only, required) The current revision number of the custom embed, which must be provided for updates. * **name**: (String, optional) The name of the custom embed as displayed to users. Must be between 1 and 100 characters. * **enabled**: (Boolean, optional) Determines if the custom embed is active on the site. Defaults to `true`. * **loadOnce**: (Boolean, optional) If true, the embed loads only during initial site rendering. Defaults to `true`. * **domain**: (String, optional) The site domain connected to the embed, if applicable. * **position**: (Enum, optional) Specifies where the custom embed code is placed on the page. Possible values are `HEAD`, `BODY_START`, `BODY_END`. * **embedData**: (Object, optional) Contains data for the custom embed. * **category**: (Enum, required) The category of the custom embed. Possible values are `ESSENTIAL`, `FUNCTIONAL`, `ANALYTICS`, `ADVERTISING`, `DATA_TO_THIRD_PARTY`. * **html**: (String, optional) The HTML content for the custom embed. Maximum length is 15000 characters. **Return Type:** * **UpdateCustomEmbedResponse**: An object containing the updated `customEmbed` details. --- ... 13 more lines ... > Next: read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/update-custom-embed using the suitable read tool to get the complete code examples and method description. > If you need more detail about the request or response shape, read the full method schema using the suitable tool. --- #### [site-updated](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/account-level/sites/sites/site-updated) # Webhook: Site Updated # Webhook Doc link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/account-level/sites/sites/site-updated # Webhook Description: Triggered when a site is updated. # Webhook Permissions Scopes IDs: Read Site Data: SCOPE.ACC-DC-OS.READ-SITE --- #### [business-management/custom-embeds/sample-flows](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/sample-flows) ## Resource: Sample Flows ## Article: Sample Flows ## Article Link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/sample-flows ## Article Content: # Sample Flows This article shares some possible use cases you could support, as well as an example flow that supports each use case. You're certainly not limited to these use cases, but they can be a helpful jumping off point as you plan your implementation. ## Manage a site's custom embeds You can manage custom embeds on a site, including updating the embeds' positions after a site structure update. This flow demonstrates how to list existing embeds, update their content and position, and create new embeds. 1. Call [List Custom Embeds](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-management/custom-embeds/list-custom-embeds) to retrieve the existing custom embeds. The change will be applied immediately upon the next site render. 2. Call [Update Custom Embed](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-management/custom-embeds/update-custom-embed) to change the content and position of an embed. You must pass the embed ID, revision, and the fields to update. 3. When relevant, call [Create Custom Embed](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-management/custom-embeds/create-custom-embed) to add a new custom embed. ## Add a banner to a site with a custom embed You can add a banner to a Wix site with a custom embed. To add a banner to a site: ... 2 more lines ... > Next: read the full article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/sample-flows using the suitable read tool. --- #### [business-management/custom-embeds/introduction](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/introduction) ## Resource: Introduction ## Article: Introduction ## Article Link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/introduction ## Article Content: # About the Custom Embeds API The Custom Embeds API allows you to embed custom HTML and JavaScript code into specific positions on Wix site pages. This enables you to add custom functionality to enhance your site's capabilities. With the Custom Embeds API, you can: - Create custom embeds with HTML and JavaScript code. - Position embeds in the page head or body tags. - Enable or disable embeds without deleting them. - Monitor embed changes by listening to webhooks. ## Categories and loading behavior Embeds are classified into categories that determine their loading behavior:
1. **ESSENTIAL** - Critical functionality required for site operation. - Always loaded, regardless of user preferences. - Tags will be returned in the HTML immediately. - Examples: Core functionality scripts, required third-party integrations. ... 73 more lines ... > Next: read the full article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/introduction using the suitable read tool. --- #### [custom-embed-updated](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/custom-embed-updated) # Webhook: Custom Embed Updated # Webhook Doc link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/custom-embed-updated # Webhook Description: Triggered when a custom embed is updated. # Webhook Permissions Scopes IDs: SCOPE.EDITOR.MANAGE_CUSTOM_EMBEDS: SCOPE.EDITOR.MANAGE_CUSTOM_EMBEDS ## Resource: Sample Flows ## Article: Sample Flows ## Article Link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/page-optimization-v1/sample-flows ## Article Content: # Page Optimization: Sample Flows This article presents possible use cases and corresponding sample flows that you can support. It provides a useful starting point as you plan your implementation. ## Optimize a page for its focus keyword A site owner picked a focus keyword for their services page and wants the page's text rewritten to rank for it. Your app runs an optimization job and presents each suggested change for approval. > **Prerequisite:** The page has a focus keyword set in its SEO settings, for example with the [Item SEO Tags API](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/item-seo-tags-v1/introduction). To optimize a page: 1. Call [Trigger Page Optimization](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/page-optimization-v1/trigger-page-optimization) with the page's `pageId` and its URL path in `pagePath`, for example `/services`. Keep the returned `predictionId`. 1. Poll [Get Page Optimization Results](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/page-optimization-v1/get-page-optimization-results) with `?predictionId=` every few seconds. While `status` is `IN_PROGRESS`, keep polling. Generation typically takes under 2 minutes. 1. When `status` is `COMPLETED`, read `pageOptimization`. Present `metaTitle`, `metaDescription`, `h1`, `h2OrH3`, and each entry of `content` as a before/after pair the owner can accept or reject. 1. For each accepted pair, locate the element on the page by its `before` text and replace it with `after`. Apply the title tag and description tag through the page's SEO settings, for example with the [Item SEO Tags API](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/item-seo-tags-v1/introduction). 1. If `status` is `FAILED`, call [Trigger Page Optimization](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/page-optimization-v1/trigger-page-optimization) again to retry. ## Optimize the homepage Your app offers a one-click SEO boost for the homepage. The homepage represents the whole site rather than one topic, so it has its own trigger method with homepage-specific guidance. ... 6 more lines ... > Next: read the full article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/page-optimization-v1/sample-flows using the suitable read tool. --- #### [business-solutions/e-commerce/get-started/apps/develop-a-business-solution-item-page-with-blocks](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/get-started/apps/develop-a-business-solution-item-page-with-blocks) ## Resource: Develop a business solution item page with Blocks ## Article: Develop a Business Solution Item Page with Blocks ## Article Link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/get-started/apps/develop-a-business-solution-item-page-with-blocks ## Article Content: # Develop a Business Solution Item Page with Blocks When you [build a business solution on top of the Wix eCommerce platform](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/get-started/apps/build-a-business-solution), you need at least one page in your app that exposes eCommerce functionality and allows site visitors to make purchases. This is known as an item page. When a site owner installs your app on their site, any item pages you create are included in the installation and displayed to site visitors on the site. An item page displays information about your item, including images. It uses the [Wix eCommerce frontend API](https://dev.wix.com/docs/sdk/frontend-modules/ecom/introduction) to allow site visitors to view their cart and navigate to checkout from the item page. An example of an item page is the Wix Stores product page. This page lets a customer on a site view details about a product, and updates the customer’s cart or navigates to checkout when the customer clicks certain buttons. The product page is installed automatically whenever a user adds Wix Stores to their site. ![Stores item page example](https://wixmp-833713b177cebf373f611808.wixmp.com/images/f7f2702328a8f63bd4fc6d4879923297.png) This article explains how to create an item page in [Blocks](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/develop-an-app-with-blocks/about-wix-blocks) as part of your business solution. ## Before you begin Before getting started, make sure that you: - Create an app on the [Custom Apps page](https://manage.wix.com/account/custom-apps). - Configure your app to [install Wix eCom](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-solutions/e-commerce/wix-e-commerce-platform-handbook/get-started/apps/build-a-business-solution#step-1--set-up-automatic-installation-of-the-ecommerce-app). - Create an item catalog and implement the [Catalog service plugin](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/business-solutions/e-commerce/service-plugins/catalog-service-plugin/introduction). ## Step 1 | Design a site widget in Blocks ... 183 more lines ... > Next: read the full article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/e-commerce/get-started/apps/develop-a-business-solution-item-page-with-blocks using the suitable read tool. --- #### [wix.seo.suggestions.v1.PageOptimizationService.TriggerHomePageOptimization](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/page-optimization-v1/trigger-home-page-optimization) # Package: seo # Namespace: pageOptimizationV1 # Method: Trigger Home Page Optimization # Method link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/page-optimization-v1/trigger-home-page-optimization # Method API Endpoint: POST https://www.wixapis.com/seo/suggestions/v1/page-optimization/trigger-home ## Method Code Examples ### Available request examples - Start optimizing the site's homepage > These are the request examples found in this result. Read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/page-optimization-v1/trigger-home-page-optimization and locate an example by its exact title to get it complete. --- Code Example: Start optimizing the site's homepage --- ### Start optimizing the site's homepage ```javascript curl -X POST \ 'https://www.wixapis.com/seo/suggestions/v1/page-optimization/trigger-home' \ -H 'Authorization: ' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{ "pageId": "c1dmp", "pagePath": "/" }' ``` --- Method Response Shape --- ## Method Response Shape ```json { "predictionId": "string" } ``` --- Method Description --- ## Method Description: Starts generating optimization suggestions for the site's homepage. The homepage gets its own method because its suggestions are generated with homepage-specific guidance, representing the whole site, not one topic. Same contract as Trigger Page Optimization: the homepage's focus keyword must be set first, the call returns a `predictionId` to poll, and triggering is idempotent per page while a job is in progress. Must be called with a [Wix user identity](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/authentication/about-identities). Calls made with an API key fail. ## Method Permissions: seo:suggestions:v1:page_optimization:trigger_home_page_optimization ## Method Permissions Scopes: Manage SEO Settings: SCOPE.PROMOTE.MANAGE-SEO ## Method Schema Summary: This API method, `triggerHomePageOptimization`, initiates the generation of optimization suggestions specifically for a website's homepage. It requires the `pageId` (GUID of the homepage) and `pagePath` (URL path, typically `/`) as parameters. The method returns a `predictionId`, which is a GUID for the generation job that can be used to poll for results. Calls to this method must be authenticated with a Wix user identity, not an API key. The operation is idempotent if a job is already in progress for the page. **Parameters:** * `pageId`: (string) The GUID of the site's homepage. Required. * `pagePath`: (string) The URL path of the homepage. Required. **Return Type:** * `predictionId`: (string) A GUID for the generation job. **Questions and Answers:** 1. **What does the `triggerHomePageOptimization` method do?** ... 9 more lines ... > Next: read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/seo/page-optimization-v1/trigger-home-page-optimization using the suitable read tool to get the complete code examples and method description. > If you need more detail about the request or response shape, read the full method schema using the suitable tool. --- #### [wix.editor.embeds.v1.CustomEmbedsService.CreateCustomEmbed](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/create-custom-embed) # Package: customEmbeds # Namespace: undefined # Method: Create Custom Embed # Method link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-management/custom-embeds/create-custom-embed # Method API Endpoint: POST https://www.wixapis.com/embeds/v1/custom-embeds ## Method Code Examples ### Available request examples - Create Custom Embed - HTTP request example > These are the request examples found in this result.
